character:zao.description: Practicality, observation, and decisive action under pressure.

character:harlan.description: Credible competence, ideological conviction, and fracture.

character:sorell.description: Curiosity, indignation, empathy, and cautious hope.

character:cael.description: Pragmatism, concentration, dry humor, and wonder.

character:proxima-technician.name: Proxima Technician
character:proxima-technician.description: Dock maintenance, schedule pressure, and operational discipline.

character:medical-officer.name: Medical Officer
character:medical-officer.description: Initial forensic examination, clinical gravity, and restrained urgency.

character:security-crew.name: Security Crewmember
character:security-crew.description: Physical authority without militarization or visible weapons.

character:earth-protesters.name: Earth Protesters
character:earth-protesters.description: Defensive fear and cautious hope, treated with equal humanity.

character:manifestante-acheron.name: Acheron Protester
character:manifestante-acheron.description: Voice of the Acheron Directive in a broadcast.

character:keene.description: Mission physician caught between clinical duty and moral uncertainty.

character:vega.description: A manipulable technician unknowingly involved in an early diversion.

character:wei.description: Responsible for the initial detection and authentication of the incoming signal.

character:hassan.description: Specialist providing physical corroboration independent of the computer investigation.

character:carvalho.description: Continues a limited part of Sorell’s linguistic work during her confinement.

character:okoye.description: Security lead forced to decide with incomplete evidence.

character:volkov.description: The source connects Volkov only to manual controls and knowledge inherited from Zao.

character:tanaka.description: Name recovered from historical documentation; available sources do not establish a dramatic function.

location:proxima-station.name: Proxima Station
location:proxima-station.description: Human science infrastructure expanded over decades: old white modules, graphite additions, and two cylindrical habitats. Jupiter appears distant; the station was not built for the gate.

location:proxima-dock.name: Proxima Axial Dock
location:proxima-dock.description: Layered, worn industrial port. Ardor was already stationed there and receives the diplomatic retrofit against the clock.

location:celestial-ardor-bridge.name: Celestial Ardor Bridge
location:celestial-ardor-bridge.description: Compact bridge with six stations around instrument consoles. The central-cylinder exit is visible in the command vestibule, while recessed service access is hidden from the crew. A small upper prograde port may offer limited observation, never an aircraft-style windshield.

location:celestial-ardor-command-vestibu.name: Command Axial Vestibule
location:celestial-ardor-command-vestibu.description: Command-deck landing where the central cylinder, lift, and bridge meet. The service-cylinder entrance is nearby but recessed beyond the consoles’ sightline.

location:celestial-ardor-central-access.name: Central Access Cylinder
location:celestial-ardor-central-access.description: Main axial trunk with handrails, rests, and hatches. In microgravity it supports safe hand-over-hand movement between decks.

location:celestial-ardor-service-cylinde.name: Service Cylinder
location:celestial-ardor-service-cylinde.description: Restricted axial conduit with peripheral technical trays, maintenance grips, and clear stretches for inertial travel. The deck communications distributor sits near command.

location:celestial-ardor-engineering.name: Celestial Ardor Engineering
location:celestial-ardor-engineering.description: Dense axial volume, exposed piping, and physical access. The ship reads as a maintainable machine, not an abstract interior.

location:diplomatic-core-room.name: Diplomatic Core Room
location:diplomatic-core-room.description: Off-axis retrofit with operational access from everyday circulation and a technical branch from the service cylinder. The cyan sphere, corrupted red state, and sealable door make the threat readable.

location:velari-wormhole-mouth.name: Velari Tunnel Mouth
location:velari-wormhole-mouth.description: Distributed field of black nodes separated by kilometres, never a ring. The 150–200 m opening exists only during the energy pulse.

location:velari-station.name: Velari Station
location:velari-station.description: Continuous organic habitat several kilometres across. Its scale, living skin, and internal ecosystems imply a civilization far older than humanity.

object:diplomatic-quantum-core.name: Diplomatic Quantum Core
object:diplomatic-quantum-core.description: Fixed human sphere about one metre wide. Cyan, red, and dark states communicate nominal operation, corruption, and isolation.

object:optical-contingency-transmitter.name: External Laser Local Control
object:optical-contingency-transmitter.description: Local console with dedicated power and physical routing to the standard external communications laser. It can aim and transmit after wireless and the ordinary wired distributor fail.

object:wired-comms-deck-patch-panel.name: Wired Communications Distributor
object:wired-comms-deck-patch-panel.description: Maintenance rack in the service cylinder with COM A/B trunks and double couplers labelled by zone. It can physically isolate a deck’s operational voice and data without cutting local systems.

object:physical-override-relay.name: Physical Override Relay
object:physical-override-relay.description: Removable module with seals, mechanical key, and irreversible fuse. Its burned state proves an event software cannot forge or restore.

object:read-only-greeting-medium.name: Sorell’s Read-only Greeting Medium
object:read-only-greeting-medium.description: Sealed optical cartridge that can store diplomatic language but cannot execute code. It is the climax’s third piece.

vehicle:celestial-ardor.description: An 80–100 m, ~300 t axial ship with D–³He torch, liquid-metal radiators, and two-week endurance. Transverse decks connect through a central cylinder, lift, and service cylinder. Its off-axis diplomatic core was retrofitted at Proxima after Earth construction.

vehicle:velari-emissary.name: Velari Emissary
vehicle:velari-emissary.description: A 300–600 m organic vehicle without visible engines, windows, or weapons. It shares the station’s skin and bioluminescence while retaining its own silhouette.

faction:velari.description: Alien civilization associated with the tunnel and remote station.
